# leilei

Independent iOS developer. Also known as 雷雷 张 and yetaimei.

- Site: https://yetaimei.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/yetaimei
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/%E9%9B%B7%E9%9B%B7-%E5%BC%A0/id1803875512

## Apps

- MoodFlow: mood tracker and emotion diary for iPhone and Apple Watch. 4.5 from 123 App Store ratings. https://yetaimei.github.io/moodflow-site/ · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/moodflow-mood-tracker-journal/id6755678705
- PosterWords: learn Mandarin through AI scene poster cards and HSK 3.0. https://posterwords.pages.dev/ · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/posterwords-learn-mandarin/id6771689623
- IntoLingo: AI bilingual stories. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/intolingo-bilingual-stories/id6762253374
- FlashTranslate: multi-style AI translate. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flashtranslate-multi-style-ai/id6759059414
- SnapFrame: screenshot frames / mockups. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/snapframe-screenshot-frames/id6787663031
- ThreadSplit: break long text into social threads. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/threadsplit-tweet-thread/id6754634135
- Life Countdown: days-left utility. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/life-countdown-days-left/id6751584119
- XCard: markdown card maker. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/xcard-markdown-card-maker/id6746029698
